name: internal_runtime_write
description: One record per account written: by a transaction, following that transaction's commit record on the same link, or by the runtime outside of one (the sysvars of block preparation and finalization, fee settlement, epoch rewards and genesis)

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number of the bank the write belongs to

phase.description: 0 for a write before the block's transactions, 1 for a transaction's write, 2 for a write after them

signature.description: First signature of the transaction for a phase 1 write; zero otherwise

commit_index_in_slot.description: For a phase 1 write, the commit order of the transaction within its slot, as its commit record carries it; 0 otherwise

touched_idx.description: For a phase 1 write, the position of this account in the transaction's touched list; 0 otherwise

is_leader.description: True if the bank is a block this validator is producing

accounts_included.description: True if account_data carries the post state data; false when account reporting is off

write_seq.description: For a phase 0 or 2 write, its 0-indexed order among the runtime writes of its bank and phase; 0 otherwise

keys.description: Account keys written by this record

touched.description: Post state of every account this record wrote

element.description: Post state of one written account

key_idx.description: Index into keys of the account written

executable.description: 1 if the post state is executable

lamports.description: Post state lamports; 0 means the account was closed

data_off.description: Offset of the post state data in account_data

data_sz.description: Size of the post state data

account_data.description: Post state data of every touched account, concatenated in touched order, empty unless accounts_included
